{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor and honored delegates of the Republic, I appear before you today to beg your forgiveness. My inexperience with the responsibilities of state has led to make a faulty judgment. I hereby reverse my decision.<br />Today I signed an agreement guaranteeing commercial exclusivity with the Trade Federation. Under the terms of this contract, Naboo and the Trade Federation will enter a new era of mutual prosperity&mdash;one which we hope will ultimately benefit all the member systems of the Republic.<br />I respectfully request that you review the legality of these documents in preparation for my return to Coruscant. Once there, I will personally confirm this agreement before the Senate. We are grateful for your patience. End transmission.|Holographic depiction of Queen Amidala of Naboo, forged by Takrab|<ref name="P" />}}
'''Gode Takrab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[trade officer]] and [[holo faker]] working for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Although the Federation had captured the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], they still needed [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] to sign an agreement to legitimize their occupation, and she was reticent to do so. Takrab's superior, [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], ordered Takrab to forge Amidala's signature in an agreement, and to create a mock [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of her. The Federation intended to send both counterfeits to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

When Amidala and her allies attacked the Federation ground headquarters on Naboo during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|second attack]] of Theed, Takrab was ordered to reach the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet to transmit the message. Although he was escorted by a security detachment in his route to his [[Gode Takrab's shuttle|shuttle]], Takrab was nonetheless intercepted and captured by the [[Naboo Resistance]]. He was unable to send the communication before the battle was over, and because Amidala survived and communicated with Coruscant herself, the forgery was rendered useless.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Even if only half of the Senate believes the message is real, the delay in achieving a legal resolution will give the Trade Federation more time to consolidate its hold on Naboo. In addition, whether or not the Queen signs the real agreement becomes completely irrelevant.|Gode Takrab|<ref name="P" />}}
Gode Takrab was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] bureaucrat. A minor [[trade officer]] working for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Takrab was a subordinate to [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] during the last [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="P" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Trade Federation secretly settled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] and sent its troops to fight a colony of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] settlers led by [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. Takrab commanded a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that were defeated during a skirmish against the Wookiees.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

Later that year, the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and captured its [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], commanding officer of the Federation, wanted the Queen to sign a treaty to legitimize their presence&mdash;but Amidala was loathe to do so, and later managed to escape.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Once the Federation had [[Capture of Theed/Legends|captured]] the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], both Haako and Takrab were assigned to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], on the surface of Naboo. Haako then ordered Takrab to create a false, but convincing, agreement with a forgery of Amidala's signature, along with a fake [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the Queen that was to be sent to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as if it were a message from her. Haako reasoned that even if the Senate did not ratify those files immediately, they would argue about its reliability, giving the Federation precious time to cement its position on Naboo.<ref name="P" />

Takrab created an agreement with the false signature and stored it electronically in the memory of his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[TC-11]]. Takrab then developed the false message, in which a simulation of Amidala held a [[data slate]] supposedly visualizing the treaty. Takrab intended to copy the electronic treaty into a real data slate once he could reach the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Naboo at that point.<ref name="P" /> Due to a loss of communications on Naboo staged by the Federation,<ref name="TPM" /> Takrab could only send the files to Coruscant from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="P" />

Shortly after Haako personally approved Takrab's work, Amidala and her allies, including the nascent [[Naboo Resistance]], [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attacked]] the Palace. Haako assigned ten security B1 battle droids to escort Takrab to his [[Gode Takrab's shuttle|shuttle]], where TC-11 and two more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were already waiting for him. Haako ordered Takrab to reach the Droid Control Ship and send his proofs to the Senate.<ref name="P" />

{{RPG|"[[Peril on Naboo]]"}}
[[File:FFTakrab1.jpg|thumb|left|Takrab, captured by Wezz, Rorwoor, and Surool]]
To avoid a firefight between other battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka's]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Takrab ordered his escort to detour through the repair bay of the Palace. There, they found a few members of the Resistance&mdash;including [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], a Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|scout]]; [[Deel Surool]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]]; and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]&mdash;who had separated from the main battle. Confident with his numerical superiority, the Neimoidian ordered his droids to attack, keeping four of them to shield him with their bodies. However, Takrab suffered a panic attack and ran through the crossfire. As the droids were programmed to not shoot at Takrab, this reduced the efficiency of his side.<ref name="P" />

The members of the Resistance defeated the droids and captured Takrab. The Neimoidian pretended to be unaware of the details of his mission and asked to be released, offering his captors a bribe if they escorted him to his shuttle. His captors found the hologram he was carrying and discovered that Takrab did know about it. Nonetheless, Takrab was confident that they would not find the treaty, stored only in his droid.<ref name="P" />

Nute Gunray then sent several other battle droids, commanded by the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] battle droid [[RK-7]], to secure Takrab's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], which was essential for Takrab's mission or as an emergency exit for Gunray should Takrab be [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Even then, Takrab did not reach the Droid Control Ship and was unable to send his forgeries.<ref name="P" /> Soon afterward, Queen Amidala captured Federation leaders Gunray and Haako, and her [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] destroyed the Droid Control Ship, deactivating the battle droids. The Federation had lost the battle. Amidala then contacted Coruscant herself and told the Senate about the situation.<ref name="TPM" /> Once she had made her statement, Takrab's forged hologram was of no use.<ref name="P" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I wish to speak to my protocol droid.|Gode Takrab|<ref name="P" />}}
Gode Takrab was a trade officer with extensive experience in the fields of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] use and [[Holo faker|counterfeiting]]. He was also familiar with other areas, including [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] and commerce. He was unable to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] ships, and did not even know the activation code of his own shuttle. Takrab was also a mediocre fighter who would rather allow others to protect his life. The possibility of suffering physical damage intimidated him, as was the norm with Neimoidians. Thus, during firefights, he was unable to keep still.<ref name="P" />

His personal effects included a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] that he was unable to use effectively. He also had a [[friend-or-foe identifier]] hidden in his cowl, an item provided to Trade Federation officers that kept battle droids from attacking them. In addition, Takrab kept two other identifiers in a secret compartment of his personal shuttle. He made heavy use of the protocol droid TC-11, having pre-established code words with him.<ref name="P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gode Takrab appears in the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure ''[[Peril on Naboo]]'', published in the sourcebook ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'' and adapted for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]].

===Alternate endings===
The player characters are supposed to capture Takrab and stop his mission, although they do not necessarily find both Takrab's forgeries. Should both be found, however, Queen Amidala would name the characters honorary [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]].

In the unlikely case that the player characters are defeated by Takrab's droids, Takrab prompts the droids to escort him to the shuttle and leave for the Droid Control Ship, not giving his fallen enemies a ''coup de grâce''.
